method_observation.observation: Activate managed infrastructure as both an eligibility system and a queueing system; nominal route availability can coexist with unusable capacity because booking, timing, sequencing, physical limits and administrative readiness are stateful constraints.

seal_effect.reason: High-importance novelty remains; major coverage gaps, negative-space review and challenger gates remain incomplete.

truth_boundary: Memory-only; no canal-specific booking rule, priority mechanism, toll, draft/water limit, queue length, transit time, closure, reroute event or current condition is verified.
